steps.name: Configure official Ubuntu mirrors
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if python3 -B scripts/ci/ci_ubuntu_mirror.py; then
  tmp=$(sudo mktemp -d /etc/apt/.ci-mirrors.XXXXXX)
  trap 'sudo rm -rf -- "$tmp"' EXIT
  sudo install -o root -g root -m 0644 /dev/null "$tmp/mirrors"
  printf '%s\n' 'https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ priority:1' 'https://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ priority:2' | sudo tee "$tmp/mirrors" >/dev/null
  sudo mv -f -- "$tmp/mirrors" /etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt
else
  echo "::warning::Unrecognized runner mirror configuration; keeping default mirrors"
fi

steps.name: Report and enforce all groups
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.request

groups = {
    'github-search': os.environ['GITHUB_RESULT'],
    'firefox-staged-pdf': os.environ['FIREFOX_RESULT'],
    'hf-capture': os.environ['CAPTURE_RESULT'],
    'huggingface-search': os.environ['HF_RESULT'],
}
# Keep this explicit manifest synchronized with the matrix business steps.
# Contract tests must compare it with the workflow whenever steps change.
common_core = (
    'Reader v3 gates', 'Run chapter-search unit tests',
    'Run chapter-bundle browser gate', 'Check DOM-search source contracts in Chromium and Firefox',
    'Run Reader core, security and search data unit tests',
)
business = {
    'github-search': {
        'static': ('Check source and exercise static gates', 'Check static dependency contracts', 'Check Reader JavaScript syntax'),
        'core': common_core,
        'loading': ('Run Reader request and PDF loading regressions', 'Check DjVu-only streams and image memory eviction', 'Check Reader request timeout in Chromium'),
        'navigation': ('Run multi-format preparation and navigation gates', 'Check TOC landing ownership and cancellation', 'Run Reader flow and cleanup regressions', 'Preserve Reader local history and bookmarks', 'Run chapter-search browser gate', 'Run PDF theme browser gate', 'Check compact mobile panel and high-density pages', 'Run full Reader refactor suite'),
        'search': ('Run search accessibility keyboard gates', 'Check search and Reader history ownership', 'Check search position persistence and pagination recovery', 'Check random reader pools and UI responsiveness', 'Check initial payload routing in both browsers', 'Check Firefox footer counter geometry', 'Check warmed Reader shell reuse', 'Test offline Pages search benchmark', 'Check GitHub search paging and snapshot contracts', 'Run remaining Reader and search browser regressions'),
    },
    'huggingface-search': {
        'static': ('Test Hugging Face history bridge', 'Check source and exercise static gates', 'Check backend coverage and quality inventory', 'Check static dependency contracts', 'Check Reader JavaScript syntax'),
        'core': common_core,
        'loading': ('Run Reader request and PDF loading regressions', 'Check DjVu-only streams and image memory eviction', 'Run Reader proxy cancellation and cached-range gate', 'Run Reader upstream ownership gate', 'Run real backend and browser integration'),
        'navigation': ('Run multi-format preparation and navigation gates', 'Check TOC landing ownership and cancellation', 'Run chapter-search browser gate', 'Run PDF theme browser gate', 'Check compact mobile panel and high-density pages', 'Run additional Hugging Face search and Reader regressions', 'Run full Reader refactor suite'),
        'search': ('Run search accessibility keyboard gates', 'Check search and Reader history ownership', 'Check Firefox footer counter geometry', 'Check Hugging Face search paging and snapshot contracts', 'Run remaining Reader and search browser regressions'),
    },
}
expected = {f'{group} ({shard})': ('Mark setup complete', *names)
            for group, shards in business.items() for shard, names in shards.items()}
lines = ['## Reader workflow results', '', '| Group | Result |', '| --- | --- |']
lines.extend(f'| {name} | {result} |' for name, result in groups.items())
lines.extend(['', '| Matrix job | Attempt | Result | Failed, skipped, or incomplete steps |', '| --- | --- | --- | --- |'])
failed = any(result != 'success' for result in groups.values())
jobs = {}
error = None
try:
    base = (f"{os.environ['API_URL']}/repos/{os.environ['REPOSITORY']}/actions/runs/"
            f"{os.environ['RUN_ID']}/attempts")
    for attempt in range(1, int(os.environ['RUN_ATTEMPT']) + 1):
        page = 1
        while True:
            request = urllib.request.Request(
                f'{base}/{attempt}/jobs?per_page=100&page={page}',
                headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['GH_TOKEN'],
                         'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
                         'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28'},
            )
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
                data = json.load(response)
            batch = data['jobs']
            if not isinstance(batch, list):
                raise ValueError('jobs API returned a non-list')
            for job in batch:
                if job.get('name') in expected:
                    jobs.setdefault((attempt, job['name']), []).append(job)
            if len(batch) < 100:
                break
            page += 1
except Exception as exc:
    error = f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
    failed = True
def cell(value):
    return str(value).replace('|', '|').replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ')
for name in sorted(expected):
    attempts = [attempt for attempt, job_name in jobs if job_name == name]
    attempt = max(attempts) if attempts else None
    matches = jobs.get((attempt, name), [])
    if len(matches) != 1:
        lines.append(f'| {cell(name)} | {cell(attempt or "—")} | missing or duplicate ({len(matches)}) | — |')
        failed = True
        continue
    job = matches[0]
    result = job.get('conclusion') or job.get('status') or 'unknown'
    steps = job.get('steps')
    if not isinstance(steps, list) or not steps:
        lines.append(f'| {cell(name)} | {attempt} | {cell(result)} | missing step data |')
        failed = True
        continue
    bad_steps = [f"{step.get('name', '?')}: {step.get('conclusion') or step.get('status') or 'unknown'}"
                 for step in steps if step.get('conclusion') != 'success']
    for required in expected[name]:
        matches = [step for step in steps if step.get('name') == required]
        if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].get('conclusion') != 'success':
            observed = matches[0].get('conclusion') or matches[0].get('status') or 'unknown' if len(matches) == 1 else f'missing or duplicate ({len(matches)})'
            bad_steps.append(f'REQUIRED {required}: {observed}')
            failed = True
    lines.append(f"| {cell(name)} | {attempt} | {cell(result)} | {cell('; '.join(bad_steps) or '—')} |")
    if result != 'success' or any(step.get('conclusion') not in ('success', 'skipped') for step in steps):
        failed = True
if error:
    lines.extend(['', f'Data incomplete — Jobs API error: {cell(error)}'])
report = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
with open(os.environ['REPORT_PATH'], 'w', encoding='utf-8') as output:
    output.write(report)
with open(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as summary:
    summary.write(report)
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
PY

setup.name: Checkout Hugging Face Search Space
setup.run:
set -euo pipefail
url=https://huggingface.co/spaces/VoiceOfML/Search
revision="$CAPTURED_REVISION"
# Admit the complete captured commit before checkout, LFS or HF execution.
# The final changed HF candidate needs a reviewed committed pin update.
python3 -I -B scripts/verify_hf_source_revision.py "$revision"
# Fetch only main and materialize its captured exact commit. Hub's
# multi-branch pack negotiation can fail before a checkout exists.
GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git clone --single-branch --branch main --no-checkout "$url" huggingface-search
GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 git -C huggingface-search checkout --detach "$revision"
test "$(git -C huggingface-search rev-parse HEAD)" = "$revision"
python3 -B scripts/select_hf_history.py huggingface-search "$revision" >/dev/null
git -C huggingface-search lfs pull
git -C huggingface-search lfs fsck
echo "revision=$revision" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    "https://huggingface.co/spaces/VoiceOfML/Search/resolve/$baseline_revision/$file" \
    --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/hf-quality-baseline/$file"
done
